s: Zzang-gu is one of several English dubs of クレヨンしんちゃん, licensed by Animation International. Its episodes were released on VCD in South Korea by Seoul-based company Gloman Co., Ltd. (글로만) from March 2001 until February 2003 as part of its "TV Ani•POPS English 21" monthly subscription learning program; the dub was also produced in said country, and is one of two English dubs of the series to be produced there.
